name: alert
useFor: Use inside a form, card or window for a note the reader should see in place: info for guidance, warning for something to check, destructive for a failure, success for a confirmation. Put a lucide glyph first, then AlertTitle and AlertDescription; add AlertAction for one small key. For a page-level notice with a title bar, use Banner.
constraints: A glyph and title in the same color as a warning
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (banner.tsx sheet and type, globals.css .win edge and the status badge colors)

description: An inline notice: a white or pale blue sheet on the window edge with a blue glyph, a display-face title and muted detail.
